newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish consumer confidence rose in November.
newsitem.headline: Finnish consumer confidence rose in November.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence rose to 13.8 points in November from 12 points in October, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
"Finns' confidence in the improvement of the economy has continuously strengthened since summer," SF said.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: one's own finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
The consumer confidence indicator was 14.2 points in September, 12.9 in August, 10.9 in July, 9.8 in June, 7.0 in May and 4.5 in April after falling from 6.1 points in March.
